performance.verdict: ROAS floor holding at 4.43x but spend surge is outpacing revenue per dollar.

findings.text: ROAS dropped 62.03% week-over-week as $1,500.07 spend outpaced revenue; 28-day ROAS is 4.43x — still above the ~3.8x test-phase floor but trending toward it.
3-day purchase signal (Sep 6–8): 1+2+5=8 purchases vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5): 4+1+1=6 — modest uptick, but Sep 8 revenue of $450.98 is the highest single day in the series.
GBP actions collapsed from a 30–40/day range to 0 for 9 consecutive days (Sep 1–8); gbp_7d_pct is -100%. Local organic demand signal is completely dark — cause unknown.

4 overdue SOW milestones (Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live, SEO Phase 1 Guardrails) all due 2026-08-31 — plus Live-Cooking Shoot 1 due 2026-08-14 — none completed.
IG reach is flat-to-declining (625 on Sep 8 vs 1,105 peak on Aug 25) while Meta spend held ~$60/day — classic reach compression suggesting creative fatigue on current ad set.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing immediately — 9 days of zero actions after 30–40/day baseline signals a listing suspension or data feed break.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 9 consecutive days (Sep 1–8) after a stable 30–40 actions/day baseline, with gbp_7d_pct at -100%. Check the Google Business Profile dashboard for suspension notices, ownership issues, or a broken data connection, and restore the listing to active status. Success is confirmed when daily GBP actions return above 15 for 3 consecutive days. Resolve by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Inject new creative (real facility footage from Haney's July 21 Drive delivery) into Meta to counter reach compression from 1,105 to 625 over 14 days.
